entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The eldest god of Theros, god of horizons, mysteries and the passage of time, who declared the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane ruled by the gods.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The other eldest god, whose return from the Underworld Kruphix does not understand.

entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: Kruphix's oracle, his primary communicator with mortals.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god, whom Kruphix sees as arrogant and a threat to the pantheon's balance.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: Death god blamed by Kruphix for Klothys's emergence.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr who rose to godhood and was defeated by Elspeth and Ajani.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who defeated Xenagos and was later betrayed by Heliod.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who with Elspeth defeated Xenagos.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Period when gods ceased interfering in mortal affairs, declared by Kruphix.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm of the gods, shaped by mortal belief.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane that invaded the multiverse, targeting Theros.

events.summary: Before Xenagos's rise, Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods to restore balance after chaos in Nyx.
events.quote: Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods

events.summary: Kruphix and his oracle observed Xenagos's defeat by Elspeth and Ajani and Heliod's later betrayal of Elspeth.
events.quote: He and his oracle observed the defeat of Xenagos by Elspeth and Ajani

events.summary: Kruphix revealed that the gods arose from mortal belief, and even he does not predate it.
events.quote: Kruphix revealed that the gods of Theros arose from mortal belief, shaping the fabric of Nyx.

events.summary: New Phyrexia invaded the multiverse, including Theros, confirming Kruphix's fears; the invasion was repelled.
events.quote: His fears proved justified when New Phyrexia invaded the multiverse

relations.note: Wary of him; prefers subtle opposition.

relations.quote: where his oracle, Kydele , serves as his primary communicator with mortals

relations.note: The two eldest gods; her return troubles him.
relations.quote: Kruphix’s only true concern is Klothys, the other eldest god
though he blames Erebos for Klothys 's unexpected emergence from the Underworld
